description: EasyLocal 3 (easylocal-legacy v3.3.1) versus EasyLocal 4 on the EasyLocal example problems. Changing this file changes the matrix key: EasyLocal 4 results of different keys are not compared, and the EasyLocal 3 baseline is measured again.

sd.description: steepest descent (EL3 SteepestDescent, EL4 BestImprovement), until a local optimum

fd.description: first descent (EL3 FirstDescent, cyclic scan; EL4 FirstImprovement, restarting scan), until a local optimum

sa.description: simulated annealing with a geometric schedule (EL3 SimulatedAnnealing, EL4 SimulatedAnnealing<Classic>)
